content: Public lx.extract builds the model, FormatHandler, Resolver, and Annotator internally and returns only an AnnotatedDocument. Upstream extraction.py and annotation.py show the same order: chunk, ContextAwarePromptBuilder.build_prompt, language_model.infer, Resolver.resolve, Resolver.align. No callback or stage-result parameter is on that path. model= is an optional prebuilt provider and skips factory schema application.
